title: Monthly dates
description: add_months(day, months) moves a date by whole months; if the day does not exist in the new month it uses the last day of that month (Jan 31 plus 1 month is Feb 28, or Feb 29 in a leap year). billing_dates(start, count) lists monthly billing dates counted from the START date, so Jan 31 gives Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31. age_in_years only counts a birthday once it has been reached.
hint: Check the month number maths, the shortest months, and whether each billing date is computed from the start or from the previous date.
